definitions.explanation: A condition where blood accumulates in a part of the body, making it appear red. Most commonly used to describe bloodshot eyes, but can refer to any area with excessive blood flow.

examples.japanese: {目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}している。
{寝不足|ねぶそく}で{目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}してしまった。
examples.english: My eyes became bloodshot from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: {花粉症|かふんしょう}のせいで{目|め}がかゆくて{充血|じゅうけつ}がひどい。
examples.english: Due to hay fever, my eyes are itchy and severely bloodshot.

notes: Most commonly used in the phrase {目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}する (eyes become bloodshot). Common causes mentioned with this word: {寝不足|ねぶそく} (lack of sleep), {花粉症|かふんしょう} (hay fever), {疲|つか}れ{目|め} (eye strain), アレルギー (allergies). Related product: {充血|じゅうけつ}{除去|じょきょ}{目薬|めぐすり} (eye drops for redness). In medical contexts, can describe congestion in other body parts as well.
